bounds: Four entrypoints with eleven boolean policy dimensions: primary database availability, registration and app status, exact deployment configuration, callback syntax, exact allowed callback, TTL and credential grant binding. Complete finite graph enumeration; one authority fact changes per step.
limitations: PKCE exchange, renewal temporal limits and key cryptography retain separate lifecycle models.
The database policy model does not prove preservation of production registry data; deployment requires a reviewed import of existing registrations and signing certificates.
